rules.rule: Infrastructure role cannot grant campaign owner or GM authority.
AIOC cannot directly mutate authoritative gameplay state.
Every operational command requires identity, permission, idempotency key, and audit receipt.
Production deployment requires verified artifact hashes and rollback readiness.
High-impact or destructive operations require explicit approval.
Hidden campaign information must be filtered from operational surfaces.
Observability data excludes credentials, private messages, and full event payloads by default.
Incident records require last known good state and evidence references.
Recovery cannot fabricate, reorder, or silently rewrite authoritative events.
Backup restoration requires integrity verification and environment isolation.
Deployment promotion requires successful health gates.
Failed health gates require pause, rollback, or explicit owner-authorized waiver.
AI cannot approve production, security, destructive, or critical incident actions.
AI cannot close a critical incident without authorized human approval.
Operational actions must remain traceable to repository, build, schema, pack, campaign, and environment.
Queued degraded-mode records cannot be treated as executed until reconciled.
Duplicate operational commands must be safely idempotent.
Secrets must be redacted from logs, alerts, diagnostics, and support bundles.
Production operations require least-privilege environment-scoped credentials.
Emergency containment must preserve audit evidence.
Session pause and recovery must preserve authoritative sequence and checkpoint references.
Diagnostic export requires user review and approval.
Operational UI must meet required accessibility profile.
Archived operational records must remain immutable and searchable.
